implementation_review.workflow: wf_d2e86462-d2d (gc-implementation-review; 6 lenses -> adversarial verify; 13 agents; post-build on commit 16c0485)
implementation_review.dominant_theme: the §3.1.4 completeness/anti-fooling mechanism was DOCUMENTED as built but was NOT actually implemented (5 of 7 findings): the guard only checked the 8 KNOWN headings for re-inlining; a NEW 9th heading passed (empirically proven by injecting '## Brand New Untracked Section' -> guard still passed); the 'behavioral matrix' was 3 isolated toContain checks, not a heading-SET equality; the guard docstring + design §5/§7 falsely asserted the mechanism existed. THIS IS THE declared-not-enforced class the whole G track closes, recurring in the track's own guard.
other_findings: no order assertion on the run.ts provenance-binding array / persisted section_bindings (a future reorder would pass) -> added guard clause 7
clause 4 (prompt-policy id set parity) had no negative test -> added
implementation_review.fix_commit_resolution: static source-region sweep made real (clause 6): every run.ts '## ' heading literal must be the `## ${FINAL_OUTPUT_SECTION_HEADINGS.<key>}` template + appendFinalOutput* emitter-count == section count -> a 9th section fails at the source (negative-tested incl. the injected case); bindings-array order = guard clause 7; clause-4 negative test added; behavioral test is now a real conditional heading-SET equality (3 conditional emitters, 2 truncation now exported); guard docstring + design §3.1.4/§5 corrected to describe what is enforced.
implementation_review.lesson: post-build adversarial review on the implementation caught the design's primary resolution being unbuilt-while-documented before PR. The hard-slice gate belongs on BOTH the design and the implementation.

confirmed_themes.resolution: v2: ALL 8 emitter headings source from the module (bare heading + '## ' prefix); guard forbids inline '## <heading>' literal; consolidates 4 copies -> 1.

confirmed_themes.theme: two orders differ (prompt-policy: claim-before-artifact; bindings: artifact-before-claim) -> a single module row order cannot drive both, and 'byte-identical' was unprotected (arrayContaining is order-insensitive)
confirmed_themes.resolution: v2: module pins PROMPT_POLICY_APPEND_SECTION_IDS (prompt-policy order) and the bound-row order (bindings order) INDEPENDENTLY; exact-ordered toEqual test on deterministic_runtime_append_sections + order assertions.

confirmed_themes.resolution: v2: run.ts DERIVES runtime-provenance-bindings.required_fragments from the module's other-4 section_ids (drift-proof by construction).

confirmed_themes.theme: the 2 truncation conditional sections have ZERO behavioral test coverage (non-exported, never populated in fixtures)
confirmed_themes.resolution: v2: export the 2 truncation emitters + behavioral matrix test asserting each emits its module heading.
